l:
シド こんにちは
《ミスリルの兜》の件ですよね？

Hello, Cid.
This is about the Mythril Helm, right?
Oh! Cid. Is this about the helm?
shido konnichiha / << misuriru no kabuto >> no ken desuyone？
ああ  詳しい話を聞かせてくれ
Yeah. Let's hear the details.
Er, yes. Mid said I should speak with you.
aa kuwashii hanashi wo kika setekure
それでは  こちらをご覧ください
Then please, take a look at this.
I'll show you the plans, then.
soredeha kochirawogo ran kudasai

ミスリル機関は 内部でミスリル鉱を燃焼させ
その熱によって動力を得て 推進力へと変換します

The mythril engine burns mythril ore inside,
harnesses the heat to generate power, and converts it into propulsion.

Here you see the mythril engine, in which mythril is burned to generate heat.
That heat is then harnessed to produce motive force.
misuriru kikan ha naibu de misuriru kou wo nenshou sase / sono netsu niyotte douryoku wo ete suishinryoku heto henkan shimasu

ミスリル鉱の燃焼では高熱が生じるため
過剰な熱を排熱装置を使って外へ逃がすわけです

Because burning mythril ore produces intense heat,
excess heat is vented outside using a cooling apparatus.

Excess heat is dealt with by means of the thermal displacement stack,
which disperses it into the surrounding air.
misuriru kou no nenshou deha kounetsu ga shouji rutame / kajou na netsu wo hainetsu souchi wo tsukatte soto he niga suwakedesu

ですが 《ミスリルの鎧》を通しただけでは
船全体が逃げた熱に曝されてしまい大変危険です
However, using just Mythril Armor would expose the entire ship to the escaping heat, which is extremely dangerous.

Now, were we to rely on thermal plating alone to achieve this effect,
the rate of excess heat buildup would far exceed the displacement coefficient of the plating.
desuga << misuriru no yoroi >> wo toushi tadakedeha / fune zentai ga nige ta netsu ni sarasa reteshimai taihenkiken desu
そこで  《ミスリルの兜》の出番というわけです
That is where the Mythril Helm comes in.
In other words, the reactor would overheat, and eventually explode.
sokode << misuriru no kabuto >> no deban toiuwakedesu

《ミスリルの兜》は その排出先を制御するとともに
熱を滞留させることで ゆっくりと冷却していきます
The Mythril Helm controls where that exhaust goes, while trapping the heat to cool it down gradually.

This is where the helm comes in—it connects to the plating, you see,
and serves as a sort of thermal sink to absorb all that excess energy.
<< misuriru no kabuto >> ha sono haishutsu saki wo seigyo surutotomoni / netsu wo tairyuu saserukotode yukkurito reikyaku shiteikimasu

温度変化に強いとされる
空の文明の遺物ならではの構造といえるでしょう
You could say it's a structure unique to the relics of the Fallen, known for resisting temperature changes.
Our experiments have shown that Fallen ceramics are remarkably thermophilic. They can withstand and absorb levels of heat far above anything we are able to make today.
ondohenka ni tsuyoi tosareru / sora no bunmei no ibutsu naradehano kouzou toierudeshou
また  開口部からの浸水を防ぐ役割もあります
It also serves to prevent water from entering through the openings.

And not only that—they're also waterproof and immune to rust,
making them the perfect material for our protective hood.
mata kaikoubu karano shinsui wo fusegu yakuwari moarimasu

海水や雨水が入り込むことで 熱によって水が気化
急激に膨張し 機関ごと船体破裂の危険が――

If seawater or rainwater gets in, the heat vaporizes it,
causing it to expand rapidly and threatening to rupture the engine and the entire ship...

Why, if sea or rain water were to enter the reactor proper, it would vaporize instantly.
The forces produced would tear the ship from stern to—
kaisui ya amamizu ga hairikomu kotode netsu niyotte mizu ga kika / kyuugeki ni bouchou shi kikan goto sentai haretsu no kiken gaaa
…分かった  その話はもう十分だ
...I get it. That's enough of that.
You can stop there. I understand.
… waka tta sono hanashi hamou juubun da

…ミドから 《ミスリルの兜》に使う遺物を
回収してくるよう頼まれた
...Mid asked me to retrieve a relic used for the Mythril Helm.
Mid said we might be able to use parts of a Fallen ruin?
… mido kara << misuriru no kabuto >> ni tsukau ibutsu wo / kaishuu shitekuruyou tanoma reta
その遺物はどこにある？
Where is that relic?
Where would I find it?
sono ibutsu hadokoniaru？
はい  ロストウィングから続く《ロベール林道》に
Well, it's in the Robert Scales leading from Lostwing.
Ah, yes. It's in Laubert's Pass, near Lostwing.
hai rosutouingu kara tsuzuku << robeeru rindou >> ni

ですが 最近あの辺りに
凶悪な魔物が棲み着いているとの噂がありまして
However, there have been rumors lately that a vicious monster has made its home around there.

The thing is...well, I probably should have arranged to have the pieces we need
brought here sooner. You see, a certain...unwanted visitor has taken up residence there.
desuga saikin ano atari ni / kyouaku na mamono ga sumi tsui teirutono uwasa gaarimashite
魔物さえいなければ  我々だけでも回収できるのですが…
If not for the monster, we could retrieve it ourselves, but...

It's no longer a matter of just walking in and taking them.
It's...um...going to be considerably more dangerous than that.
mamono saeinakereba wareware dakedemo kaishuu dekirunodesuga…
つまり俺は  その魔物を倒せばいいんだな
Meaning I just need to defeat that monster, right?
I see. Then I suppose I had better deal with this "unwanted visitor" for you.
tsumari ore ha sono mamono wo taose baiindana
やってやろう
Consider it done.
Would that help?
yatteyarou
ありがとうございます  シド！
Thank you, Cid!
Oh, very much! Thank you, Cid!
arigatougozaimasu shido!

それでは 早速出発しましょう
遺跡の近くでお待ちしてますね

Then let's set out at once.
I'll be waiting near the ruins.
I'll gather my team and head there right away! We'll meet you outside the ruins!
soredeha sassoku shuppatsu shimashou / iseki no chikaku deo machi shitemasune

ああ シド
お待ちしておりました

Ah, Cid.
We've been expecting you.
Oh, there you are, Cid. Um, thanks so much for coming.
aa shido / o machi shiteorimashita

目的の遺物は この先の遺跡付近に
噂の魔物も おそらくその辺りにいるかと…

The relic we're after should be near the ruins just ahead,
and the monster folks are talking about is likely around there too...

The, er, ruins are just over there. As is the creature I told you about, I'd imagine.
Would you, er... Would you mind?
mokuteki no ibutsu ha kono sakino iseki fukin ni / uwasa no mamono mo osorakusono atari niirukato…

俺が様子を見てくる
少し待っていろ

I'll go take a look.
Wait here a minute.
Of course. I'll be right back.
ore ga yousu wo mite kuru / sukoshi matsu teiro
あそこか…
Is that it...?
Anybody home...?
asokoka…
（トルガルの吠え声）
(Torgal’s howl)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no hoe koe)
こいつが噂の魔物だな！　やるぞ！
So this is the monster folks were talking about! Let's do this!
This must be our unwanted visitor. Time to go.
koitsuga uwasa no mamono dana! yaruzo!
…片づいたな
...That's taken care of.
The things I do for you, Mid...
… katazu itana
さすが  シド！　お見事でした！
As expected of Cid! Magnificent!
Cid! Thank goodness you're safe!
sasuga shido! o migoto deshita!
あとのことは任せる
I'll leave the rest to you.
You shouldn't have any trouble now.
atonokotoha makase ru

はい 責任を持って遺物を回収し
隠れ家へ運んでおきます

Right. We'll recover the relic and bring it back to the hideout,
leaving no room for failure.

Indeed. Well, don't let us keep you. We'll, um...see that everything is transported
safely back to the hideaway.
hai sekinin wo motsu te ibutsu wo kaishuu shi / kakure ie he hakon deokimasu

頼んだぞ
ミドには俺から伝えておこう

I'm counting on you.
I'll let Mid know myself.
Alright. I'll let Mid know you're on your way.
tanon dazo / mido niha ore kara tsutae teokou

よう クライヴ
お疲れさん

Hey, Clive.
Good work.
Alright, Clive. How's tricks?
you kuraivu / o tsukare san

ミドを墓参りに連れていくってだけで
とんだ騒ぎになっちまったな

Just talking about taking Mid to visit the graves
made quite a fuss out of it.

Mid finished sending half the hideaway traipsing across the Twins, has she?
I swear, that girl'd do anything to put off visiting her old dad's grave.
mido wo hakamairi ni tsure teikuttedakede / tonda sawagi ninatchimattana
それで  あいつはどうした？
So, where is she?
No excuses now, though, eh?
sorede aitsuhadoushita？

“やること”を思い出したらしい
すぐに片づけるから 少し待つようにと

Seemingly she remembered something she had to do.
She said she'd finish it right away, so to wait a bit.

Not quite. She said there was one final "thing" she had to take care of.
I'm sure she'll be finished soon enough.
“ yarukoto ” wo omoidashi tarashii / suguni katazu kerukara sukoshi matsu younito
…ミドがそう言ったのか？
...Mid said that?
She said that? In those words?
… mido gasou itta noka？
そうだが…？
She did, but...?
She...did, yes...
soudaga…？
クライヴ…
Clive...
Clive...
kuraivu…
そりゃ  あいつが面倒事から逃げるときの常套句だ
That's her go-to line when she's running away from trouble.
Were you born yesterday or something? There is no "thing."
sorya aitsuga mendou koto kara nige rutokino joutouku da
ミドの奴  墓参りをすっぽかすつもりだぞ
That Mid... she plans to ditch the grave visit.
She'll probably be halfway to Kanver by now.
mido no yatsu hakamairi wosuppokasutsumoridazo

…まったく
デッキを見てくる

...Good grief.
I'll go check the deck.
Mid... I might still be able to catch her.
… mattaku / dekki wo mite kuru
オボルス  ミドを見なかったか？
Obolus, have you seen Mid?
Obolus, have you seen Mid?
oborusu mido wo mina kattaka？
さっき出てったぜ
She just left.
Yeah. In a boat. Going that way.
sakki dete ttaze
遅かった…
Damn it...
Then I'm too late...
osoka tta…

向こう岸まで送ろうとしたら 小舟を１艘買い取って
そのまま自分で漕いでいっちまったさ

I offered to take her across, but she bought a skiff
and rowed off in it herself.

You in an 'urry and all, are you? I offered to take her across, but she wouldn't wait.
Just paid for a dinghy and rowed off, oars going like the clappers.
mukou kishi made okuro utoshitara kobune wo 1 sou kaitotsu te / sonomama jibun de koi deitchimattasa
相変わらず  元気な嬢ちゃんだ
Spirited little lass, same as ever.
Got some life in her, ain't she?
aikawarazu genki na jou chanda

…そうそう
ちょうど俺も シドに用があった

...Oh, that's right.
I had some business with Cid anyway.
But anyway. I was on my way up to see you, as it happens.
… sousou / choudo ore mo shido ni you gaatta
あんた宛の手紙を預かってる
I'm holding a letter addressed to you.
Got a letter for you.
anta ate no tegami wo azuka tteru

何でも急ぎだからって
ロズフィールド卿の使用人から直接渡されてな
Said it was urgent, handed right to me by Lord Rosfield's servant.

Urgent, by the sound of it. One of your uncle's men said I was to
hand it to you in person post-bleedin'-haste. And you're here now.
nande mo isogi dakaratte / rozufiirudo kyou no shiyounin kara chokusetsu watasa retena
ありがとう  オボルス
Thanks, Obolus.
Thank you, Obolus.
arigatou oborusu
いいってことよ
Don't mention it.
Don't mention it.
iittekotoyo
叔父さんは  一体何を…
Just what is Uncle...
What tidings, Uncle?
oji sanha ittainani wo…
ガブをカンベルに…
Gav to Kanver...
Trouble in Kanver...
gabu wo kanberu ni…
名指しとなれば  奴も喜びそうだ
If he's named specifically, he'll likely be pleased.
Well, I'll need someone to keep an eye on Mid.
nazashi tonareba yatsu mo yorokobi souda

…それじゃ結局
ミドに上手いこと乗せられたってことか？

So basically Mid completely played us,
is that it?
...So what, Mid got us to do all her dirty work, and then just sailed off into the sunset?
… soreja kekkyoku / mido ni umai koto nose raretattekotoka？
まんまとやられたよ
She got us good.
It seems that way.
manmatoyararetayo
いなくなっちまったもんは仕方ない
Nothing we can do about her running off now.
Well, nothing we can do about it now.
inakunatchimattamonha shikatanai
次の機会には  是が非でも連れていってやる
Next time, we're taking her with us no matter what.

But next time you plan on visiting Cid,
you might want to tie her to something before you suggest it.
tsugino kikai niha zegahidemo tsure teitteyaru

しかし みんなで何かをつくったのなんて
この隠れ家を建てたときくらいだ

Still, the last time we all built something together
was back when we put this hideout up.

Ah, don't be so hard on her. Got to admit, the dirty work was kind of fun—
everyone pitching in, all that bollocks.
shikashi minnade nanika wotsukuttanonante / kono kakure ie wo tate tatokikuraida
楽しかったよ
It was fun.
Just like when we built this place.
tanoshika ttayo
ああ  そうだな
Yeah, it was.
You're right.
aa soudana

…さて 俺は墓参りに付き合ったら
カンベルまで行ってくるわ

...Well, once I've been to the graves,
I'm heading over to Kanver.

Anyway, we all set to head to the old hideaway?
I could do with getting to Kanver pretty sharpish.
… sate ore ha hakamairi ni tsukiatsu tara / kanberu made itte kuruwa

ロズフィールド卿のご指名とあれば
断るわけにもいかないぜ

When Lord Rosfield asks for you by name,
not like I can say no.

Wouldn't do to keep Lord Rosfield of the Seven High Houses waiting, now, would it?
Not after he asked for me personally.
rozufiirudo kyou nogo shimei toareba / kotowaru wakenimoikanaize

俺も その足で出かける
また留守を頼むぞ オットー

I'll be heading out straight from there, too.
Look after things while we're gone, Otto.
Gav will be leaving with me. Will you mind the place while we're gone?
ore mo sono ashi de deka keru / mata rusu wo tanomu zo ottoo
任せておけ
Leave it to me.
You can count on me.
makase teoke
シドとみんなに  よろしくな
And give my regards to Cid and everyone.
Just be sure to give Cid and the others my regards, alright?
shido tominnani yoroshikuna

そうだ クライヴ
ジルから伝言があった

Oh, right, Clive.
Jill left a message for you.
Oh, by the way—Jill'll be joining us too.
souda kuraivu / jiru kara dengon gaatta
少し遅れるから  現地で合流するってさ
She's running a bit late, so she'll meet up with us there.
She's got some things to care of, but she'll meet us there.
sukoshi okure rukara genchi de gouryuu suruttesa
それじゃ  俺たちだけで先に行こう
Then let's head on ahead, just the two of us.
I hope she's telling the truth, at least...
soreja ore tachidakede sakini iko u
…グツ  ここにいたのか
...Goetz, there you are.
Ah, Goetz. There you are.
… gutsu kokoniitanoka

クライヴ…！
どうしよう…婆さんに叱られる…！

Clive...!
What am I going to do... Granny's going to yell at me...!
Clive! I, I'm so sorry! Don't tell Nan, will you!?
kuraivu…! / doushiyou… baasan ni shikara reru…!

落ち着くんだ グツ
何があった？

Calm down, Goetz.
What happened?
Slow down, Goetz. Just tell us what happened.
ochitsuku nda gutsu / nani gaatta？
商人札を失くしちゃったんだ…！
I lost my merchant's pass...!
It's my trader's pass! It's gone!
shounin satsu wo naku shichattanda…!

あれがないと 乗合馬車に乗れない…！
関所も抜けられないよ…！

Without that, I can't take the stagecoach...
And I won't get past the checkpoint...!

We cannae ride the caravan without it!
We won't even be able to get through the flipping checkpoint!
areganaito noriai basha ni nore nai…! / sekisho mo nuke rarenaiyo…!
心当たりはない？
Do you have any idea where it might be?
Do you remember when you last saw it?
kokoroata rihanai？
そういえば  さっき子供がぶつかってきて…！
Now that you mention it, a kid bumped into me earlier...!
It was in my pocket a minute ago...but then a bairn bumped into me, and—
souieba sakki kodomo gabutsukattekite…!

あぁぁぁぁ…ひょっとして…！
そのときにスられたのかも…！

Aaaah... Could it be...
Maybe I had it stolen right then...!
Here...y-you don't think that they might've nicked it, do you!?
aaaaa… hyottoshite…! / sonotokini su raretanokamo…!

子供のスリか…
俺たちだけで見つけ出すのは厳しそうだな

A child pickpocket...
Finding them on our own isn't going to be easy.
It wouldn't surprise me. A busy market like this is prime territory for pickpockets.
kodomo no suri ka… / ore tachidakede mitsu ke dasu noha ikameshiso udana
ええ  誰か手を貸してもらえたらいいんだけど…
Yes, if only someone could lend us a hand...
So to get the pass back, we need to find this child. Where would we even start?
ee dareka te wo kashi temoraetaraiindakedo…

それなら 頼れる人がいる
ちょっとした顔馴染みなんだ

If that's the case, I know someone we can count on.
We go back a bit.
I-I know where! I've got a pal in Boklad who might be able to help us!
sorenara tayore ru nin gairu / chottoshita kaonajimi minanda

この市場のことにも詳しいし
力になってくれるかもしれない

They know their way around this market, too,
so they might be able to help.
No one knows more about what goes on round here than she does.
kono shijou nokotonimo kuwashii shi / chikara ninattekurerukamoshirenai
その人はどこに？
Where is this person?
Where do we find her?
sono nin hadokoni？

この先にある《赤の商隊》って店だよ
赤チョコボの看板が目印の

At a place further ahead called The Crimson Caravans.
Look for the red Chocobo sign.
She's the owner of the Crimson Caravans, up that way. Sign's got a red chocobo on it.
kono sakini aru << akano shou tai >> tte mise dayo / aka chokobo no kanban ga mejirushi no
行ってみましょう
Let's go see.
No time like the present.
itte mimashou
ふたりは先に行ってて！
You two go on ahead!
Youse two go on ahead.
futariha sakini itte te!

オレは ほかに盗られたものがないか
荷物を確認して向かうから！
I'm going to check my luggage to make sure nothing else was stolen, then I'll catch up!
I'm gonna check the rest of my stuff, make sure nowt else is missing...
ore ha hokani tora retamonoganaika / nimotsu wo kakuninshi te muka ukara!
分かった  早く来いよ
Understood. Hurry up.
Alright. We'll meet you there.
waka tta hayaku koi yo

ダルメキアが自治領島に進軍してから
交易の窓口だったこの市場にも軍隊がやってきたわ

Ever since Dhalmekian forces marched on the Dominion island,
the soldiers have come to this market, our trading hub.

Ever since the Fist marched on the Dominion, the republic has been clamping down on
any commerce that might aid the empire more than it does us.
darumekia ga jichiryou shima ni shingun shitekara / koueki no madoguchi dattakono shijou nimo guntai gayattekitawa

少し前から関所の警備も強化されて 裏書のある身分でないと
自治領島へ行くことすらできなくなったのよ
Security at the checkpoint was tightened a while back, and now you can't even get to the island without properly endorsed papers.

Which means trader's passes have gone from being merely a way of easing one's progress
to being essential if one wishes to cross the border at all.
sukoshi zenka ra sekisho no keibi mo kyouka sarete uragaki noaru mibun denaito / jichiryou shima he iku kotosuradekinakunattanoyo

だから最近は 人様の商人札を偽装して
潜り込もうとする輩まで現れたってわけ
Which is why lately, we've even had people forging other merchants' passes to try and sneak in.

And with demand outstripping supply, they've become a precious commodity...
leading some to seek to acquire them by less than legitimate means.
dakara saikin ha hitosama no shounin satsu wo gisou shite / moguri komo utosuru yakara made araware tattewake
盗られた商人札が  裏で売買されている…？
The stolen passes are being bought and sold behind the scenes...?
So the children are stealing passes to sell on the black market?
tora reta shounin satsu ga urade baibai sareteiru…？

…ご明察
でも それだけじゃない

...Spot on.
But that's not all of it.
Yes...and no.
… go meisatsu / demo soredakejanai

偽装された商人札に 一切の足が付いてないの
子供たちだけでできることじゃないわ

Those forged merchant passes don't leave any trace at all.
It's not something children could pull off on their own.

Passes are inscribed with the names of their owners. And yet none of the victims' names
have appeared on the register of those passing through the checkpoint.
gisou sareta shounin satsu ni issai no ashi ga tsui tenaino / kodomo tachidakededekirukotojanaiwa
どういうことだ？
What do you mean?
Which means?
douiukotoda？
このスリは  組織的に行われてるのよ
These pickpockets are working as an organization.
That someone is doctoring the stolen passes.
kono suri ha soshikiteki ni okonawa reterunoyo
誰かが子供たちを使ってスリをさせてる
Someone is using the children to steal.
The same someone who is encouraging the children to steal them.
dareka ga kodomo tachiwo tsukatte suri wosaseteru

きっと グツがスられた商人札も
すでに元締めに渡ってるでしょうね
I'm sure the merchant pass Goetz had stolen has already made its way to the mastermind, too.
And the same someone who has Goetz's pass, no doubt.
kitto gutsu ga su rareta shounin satsu mo / sudeni motojime ni watatsu terudeshoune

このままスリが横行すれば いずれは市場全体の客足が落ちて
私たち商人は立ち行かなくなってしまう
If pickpocketing keeps running rampant like this, before long the customers will stop coming to the market altogether, and we merchants won't be able to survive.

Whoever they are, they're ruining the livelihoods of honest merchants.
Which is why we've decided to take a stand.
konomama suri ga oukou sureba izureha shijou zentai no kyakuashi ga ochi te / watashitachi shounin ha tachi ika nakunatteshimau
――ねえ  ここは協力しない？
...So, what do you say we work together?
Will you stand with us?
-- nee kokoha kyouryoku shinai？
あんたたちは  商人札を取り戻したい
You want to get your merchant pass back.
You want to get your pass back.
antatachiha shounin satsu wo tori modoshi tai
